event_summary: A small brown round object enters from the left, moves across the tabletop in front of a stationary white block, and exits at the right.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a light wood-grain tabletop, a white textured rectangular block near the rear center, and a partially visible black cylindrical object at the left edge. After a period with no moving object visible, a small brown round object appears from the lower-left side, moves rightward across the tabletop with visible blur and changing appearance, passes in front of the white block without visible contact, continues to the right edge, and disappears from view. The white block, tabletop, and black left-edge object remain visibly unchanged.

reasons: The tabletop and white rectangular block are clearly visible before the brown moving object appears.
A black cylindrical object is partially visible at the left edge.
No moving brown object is visible in the first frame.
